selection: Eight editorial practice exercises selected to complement the existing six OOP LLD implementations. No company-frequency ranking or universal interview format is claimed.

sources.title: Atlassian engineering interview guide
sources.use: One employer example of coding interviews including code design and discussion of trade-offs; not a universal format.

sources.title: C++ Core Guidelines, error handling
sources.use: Invariants, preconditions and scope-owned resource cleanup; living guidance, not proof of every program's exception guarantee.

sources.title: GCC 12.2 warning options
sources.use: Diagnostic flags matching the installed compiler version. Actual C++17 builds and outputs are separately recorded.

sources.title: C++ working draft, priority_queue
sources.use: Priority queue ordering contract; live draft may contain facilities beyond C++17. The exercise uses and compiles only its C++17 subset.

sources.title: RFC 9923: The FNV Non-Cryptographic Hash Algorithm
sources.use: 32-bit FNV-1a arithmetic and constants. Informational independent-stream RFC, not an Internet Standard; not suitable as an authorization mechanism.

authored_contracts: All exercise scopes, adapter protocols, fixture inventories, version policies, timings and scoring rubrics are local educational choices, not copied employer questions.
